PJA 0.9.8 (tag v0.9.8, commit e89a500), https://github.com/YadeWira/PJA,
from the vendor tarball pja-0.9.8-zpaqstd.tar.gz of its release (sha256
f777a59f904be361e337b3fcdf285d9647b9a2d70659adf5c668d186d51c5cdc, as its
SHA256SUMS says), copied unmodified, as zpaq-std, PMPA and POA vendor it
(two PJA codecs do not fit in one program).

PPA uses it for the JPEG inside a JNG (its JDAT, and JDAA for the alpha):
pjacodec.Compress, pjacodec.Decompress. PJA 0.9.8 reads every stream PJA
0.6.1 wrote, so PPA still reads every .ppa of a JNG it wrote before; one
PPA writes now may carry a PJA stream an older PPA refuses as a newer
one's. MIT (LICENSE); NOTICE has PJA's third-party notes.

Do not patch these files here: changes go to the PJA repository, and a new
release tag comes in whole, replacing this directory.
